function.name: bash

arguments.command:
D=/data/current.db; sqlite3 $D "
WITH att AS (SELECT operation_id, COUNT(*) natt FROM attempt_events GROUP BY 1),
fin AS (SELECT operation_id, MAX(attempt_no) mx FROM attempt_events GROUP BY 1),
ops AS (SELECT lo.operation_id, lo.opened_at_ms, att.natt,
 CASE WHEN lo.opened_at_ms<1777719600000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END period, lo.route_id,
 (SELECT ra.pool_id FROM route_assignments ra WHERE ra.route_id=lo.route_id AND ra.effective_from_ms<=lo.opened_at_ms AND ra.effective_to_ms>lo.opened_at_ms) pool_id,
 (SELECT pp.deadline_ms FROM route_assignments ra JOIN policy_profiles pp ON pp.profile_id=ra.profile_id WHERE ra.route_id=lo.route_id AND ra.effective_from_ms<=lo.opened_at_ms AND ra.effective_to_ms>lo.opened_at_ms) dl
 FROM logical_operations lo JOIN service_routes sr ON sr.route_id=lo.route_id AND sr.service_id=1 JOIN att ON att.operation_id=lo.operation_id
 WHERE lo.opened_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND lo.opened_at_ms<1777723200000)
SELECT period, pool_code, COUNT(*) ops, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 AND a.attempt_no=f.mx THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/COUNT(*), SUM(natt), SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN fc.is_success=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/SUM(natt), SUM(CASE WHEN natt>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), MIN(dl), MAX(dl)
FROM ops o JOIN attempt_events a ON a.operation_id=o.operation_id JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=a.code_id JOIN fin f ON f.operation_id=o.operation_id JOIN worker_pools w ON w.pool_id=o.pool_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;"
echo ---
sqlite3 $D "SELECT w.pool_code, s.signal_code, s.unit, lo.opened_at_ms BETWEEN 1777716000000 AND 1777719600000 p, ROUND(AVG(ts.value),3) FROM telemetry_samples ts JOIN worker_pools w USING(pool_id) JOIN telemetry_signals s USING(signal_id) JOIN (SELECT pool_id FROM worker_pools WHERE pool_id IN (1,2)) x ON x.pool_id=ts.pool_id WHERE ts.measured_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND ts.measured_at_ms<1777723200000 GROUP BY p, w.pool_code, s.signal_code ORDER BY p, w.pool_code, s.signal_code;" | head -20
